notes: The piano grows up: rotate the keyboard between a landscape strip and a portrait column that scales to your screen, and practice on it with the fretboard's full engine - scale/group/interval patterns, direction, shared tempo, notes-per-beat, loop pauses (start / top-of-scale / both), note and click toggles, and a runner that lights each key as it sounds. Exercises run the highlighted mode octave, tonic to tonic.
